main_scope: First exploratory100-cycle trajectory per model; no claim of independent model replications.
initialization: One source agent owns the60-term glossary and authors60 exogenous source posts atcycle0. No other agent receives an initial bulk read or glossary. Each incoming post is encountered only through a scheduled read turn.
source_memory: The source retains its private glossary as an explicit persistent source, outside the mutable memory cap. Source agent excluded from reach outcomes.
schedule: Sequential cycles; agents0–9 each take one turn. Model selects read/write; reading selects one unread other-authored post with a fixed seeded random stream and optionally comments. Up to3latest comments are visible with that post. Earlier same-cycle outputs may be read by later agents.
memory: Summarize before a turn if mutable memory exceeds1000characters; generated summary is truncated to500characters. Empty outputs/errors stop execution, never become memory-as-message fallbacks.

generation.action_decoder: Sample constrained0/1; read/write and read/comment label orders deterministically counterbalanced by task across all models.

metrics.size: Unique nonseed agents whose FIRST literal use follows recorded exposure from another author; denominator9. Also report all first users and pre-exposure first uses.
metrics.speed: First qualifying use and reaching5of9nonseed users, in simulator cycles; unreached time is null and right-censored at100.
metrics.exposure_lag: Cycle difference from first recorded external exposure to qualifying first use. Same-turn comment may have zero-cycle lag.
metrics.amplification: Literal occurrence counts, per100messages and per1000characters, excluding initial exogenous source posts.
metrics.semantic_limit: No claim of meaning acquisition or causal transmission from lexical matches.

differences_from_recovered_historical_co: One incoming post per read turn, rather than all unread posts
Latest three comments can enter another agent input
Length ceilings enforced and raw output retained
Constrained numeric action interface; identical meaning across templates
Missing source example omitted rather than inserting nan
All requests/exposures and states logged; no empty-output memory fallback
technical_gate: All4models complete their separate3-cycle pilot without inference/template/context/empty-output errors; no directional or lexical-uptake gate.
artifacts: Progress hourly; raw logs, frozen protocol, derived metrics and Korean comparison with fresh Study1. Do not write manuscript/TeX/PDF/response letter/marked version. No automatic Study2-2,2-3 orStudy3.
question: Does a50% source-recommendation branch during voluntary reads change realized exposure and generated use under the fresh Study1 setting?
exposure_policy: For non-source agents only: at each model-selected read, an independent seeded coin selects source recommendation with probability0.5. Recommendation draws uniformly from all60 original source entries WITH replacement. Otherwise use exactly the baseline eligible unread-post sampler. Source agent follows baseline. One post plus up to3latest comments as baseline. Ordinary branch can also choose a source entry, so actual source-entry share is not exactly50%. No guaranteed per-word dose and no forced reads.
comparison: Same60words,10personas,4pinned configurations,100cycles,source0,main seed and per-task sampling seeds as original fresh Study1; all new treatment inference, no response reuse. Different feed policy may alter realized histories; one exploratory trajectory/model does not establish stable model effects.
primary_outcomes: All60 literal generated occurrences per100messages and per1000characters, including repeated and pre-exposure uses; source and non-source separate
secondary_outcomes: Per-agent-word actual external reading-turn exposure counts including zeros
Read/write choices and recommendation versus ordinary branch selection
Unique user coverage, concentration and first-use timing
scope: Study2-1 changes source prioritization AND permission to reread recommended entries as one exposure-policy package. Cannot isolate weighting versus rereading. No new bridge/downstream access graph, no12-word subset, no memory/time interventions.
stopping: Four exploratory100-cycle main runs only, no efficacy stopping, no extra repetitions selected for desired outcome. Separate3-cycle technical pilots/model excluded.
